claims.summary: Remainder identity: for every refutation pi meeting thm:used-node-jet-erasure's hypotheses, with used inputs A_1..A_m, F_i=t(A_i), P the ordered product of (1-F_i), and every t>=1, under the theorem's own compiler (the noncommutative depth audit's) and translation convention (tags translate to one), C_pihat = A_t + P^t (C_Lambda - H) exactly in the free algebra, where H = sum_i (prod_(k<i)(1-F_k))(Y_i+R_i), R_i the literal-permutation certificate of input i (zero in the generator's order), and C_Lambda is the compiler's sum on the line sequence Lambda: the used inputs first, then pihat's contextual old proof with its axiom-seeding chains, input references redirected to the inputs (not a derivation of the calculus, its inputs lacking the context). So the remainder is Q = C_Lambda - H. When pi has no logical axiom A->A, C_Lambda = C_(pi^in), the compiled certificate of pi with its inputs moved first, an eligible refutation of the same size and depth: H+Q is that matched image and Q is the image minus H. With logical axioms, C_Lambda - C_(pi^in) is an explicit sum of t repetition terms per axiom and terms whose prefixes carry the factor (1-t(A))t(A).
claims.assessment: Working line-by-line comparison of the compiler's prefix sum on pihat and on Lambda, from the depth audit's compiler definition and the used-node construction's order of writing and A_t definition; exactly as conditional as thm:used-node-jet-erasure on its translation convention. Passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections. Identifies the remainder that the theorem's proof leaves as an unnamed polynomial.
claims.rationale: Shows the transformed images of refutations without logical axioms A->A are A_t + P^t times (a matched image of the same size minus H), so, under the theorem's translation convention, their jet structure adds nothing beyond the matched image for that class.
claims.next_action: Decide whether C_Lambda is the compiled certificate of some eligible polynomial-size refutation when pi has logical axioms A->A; use the identity on minimum-size images (queued item minimum-size-image-coefficients).
